method: Visual inspection of PNGs rendered by pdftoppm from PDFs exported by Word. Per-file method and steps identify UI-created samples; other samples were exported by the same Word document instance immediately after its only SaveAs2.

image/image-emf.docx.method: Windows UI: Excel copy, Word Paste Special; image-emf-ui-result.json; Word PDF; copied-ZIP ui-samples-offline-check.json
image/image-emf.docx.steps: Copy the chart from _assets/chart-paste-source.xlsx in Excel; Word Ctrl+Alt+V, select Picture (Enhanced Metafile), then save DOCX and export Word PDF.
image/image-emf.docx.observation: Word and its PDF show before 前文 above a complete chart titled 销售统计 and after 后文 below. Category 1/2/3 each has a blue Series 1 column (10/20/30) and orange Series 2 column (15/25/35), with the legend on the right. Inline picture, 415.3 x 251.05 pt, no manual or visible crop, rotation, or flip; no alternative text. Saved as one pic:pic with internal image relationship to word/media/image1.emf (29,104 bytes; valid EMF decoded as 642 x 389 pixels), without chart or OLE parts. a:srcRect is empty and a:xfrm has no rotation/flip attributes. Created through actual Excel-to-Word Paste Special UI, not by converting or injecting package XML.

canvas/canvas-shapes.docx.observation: Word PDF shows a blue rectangle with the text 画布, an orange ellipse, a blue straight line, and a blue right arrow. All four items are visible, but the canvas precedes the before marker, so this first trial fails the required before/feature/after order. Retained as an unsuccessful trial; a suffixed replacement is required. Canvas 360 x 200 pt, floating with top/bottom wrapping; Word emits wpc:wpc and wps:wsp instead of lc:lockedCanvas.

image/image-inline.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文, then one horizontal rectangle with a green left half and yellow right half, then after 后文. No visible crop, rotation, or flip. Inline embedded PNG, 144 x 72 pt; no external link; alternative text is Green and yellow color blocks, 64 by 32 pixels.

canvas/canvas-shapes-2.docx.observation: Second trial: blue rectangle labeled 画布, orange theme-colored ellipse, blue straight line and right arrow are visible and within the text margins. The whole canvas still appears above before 前文; after 后文 is below that marker. This fails the required marker order. Floating 360 x 200 pt, top/bottom wrapping, wpc:wpc with wps:wsp children; no lc:lockedCanvas. Retained unsuccessful trial.

canvas/canvas-shapes-3.docx.observation: Third trial, with the feature range selected through Word COM: the same blue labeled rectangle, orange ellipse, blue line and arrow are visible, but the canvas still precedes before 前文. The marker-order failure remains. Floating 360 x 200 pt, top/bottom wrapping; modern wpc:wpc, no lc:lockedCanvas. Retained unsuccessful trial.

canvas/canvas-shapes-4.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文 above the canvas and after 后文 below. Inside: blue rectangle with centered white 画布 text, orange theme-colored ellipse, one blue straight line and one blue right arrow. Floating canvas, 360 x 200 pt (12.7 x 7.06 cm), top/bottom wrapping. Word emits wpc:wpc and four wps:wsp children, not the requested lc:lockedCanvas/a:sp representation. This is the successful marker-order replacement for trials 1-3.

canvas/canvas-picture.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文, then a green/yellow PNG on the canvas left and a blue rectangle with white 画布 text on the right, then after 后文. Canvas 360 x 200 pt (12.7 x 7.06 cm), floating with top/bottom wrapping. PNG is 128 x 64 pt, rectangle 130 x 70 pt. Saved wrapper is wpc:wpc with a pic:pic and a wps:wsp, rather than lc:lockedCanvas.

canvas/canvas-resized.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文, then miniature versions of the blue labeled rectangle, orange ellipse, line and arrow, then after 后文. The canvas is actually 90 x 50 pt, one quarter of the original 360 x 200 pt, not the requested half-size: the first trial applied two 0.5 scales while Word locked the aspect ratio. Retained failed size trial; corrected suffixed file is required. Word emits wpc:wpc and scales child transforms directly, with no lc:lockedCanvas or chOff/chExt.

canvas/canvas-resized-2.docx.observation: Corrected Word PDF shows before 前文, the blue labeled rectangle, orange ellipse, blue line and right arrow at half the original size, then after 后文. Canvas is 180 x 100 pt (6.35 x 3.53 cm), exactly half of the original 360 x 200 pt; width and height were scaled with aspect-ratio locking disabled. Floating, top/bottom wrapping. Word directly scales each child's a:xfrm under wpc:wpc; no lc:lockedCanvas or chOff/chExt was emitted.

canvas/canvas-floating.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文 above a canvas shifted right by 65 pt; after 后文 wraps on its left beside the upper shapes. Canvas contains a blue rectangle labeled 画布, orange theme-colored ellipse, blue line and right arrow. Floating, square wrapping, 360 x 200 pt (12.7 x 7.06 cm). The file contains wp:anchor/wp:wrapSquare and wpc:wpc; the modern wrapper differs from docs/07's lc:lockedCanvas.

canvas/canvas-textbox.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文, a pale peach rectangular textbox with black border and two separate lines Canvas text paragraph one / Canvas text paragraph two, then after 后文. Textbox 300 x 125 pt inside a floating 360 x 200 pt canvas; top/bottom wrapping. Word writes wps:wsp with textbox content inside wpc:wpc; no lc:lockedCanvas.

image/image-wrap-square.docx.observation: Word PDF shows a green-left/yellow-right PNG floating to the right of the text. before 前文 is above its top; after 后文 is to its left beside the image. Square wrapping, 144 x 72 pt, horizontal offset 180 pt, paragraph vertical offset 0; embedded PNG, no crop/rotation/flip/link. Package contains wp:anchor/wp:wrapSquare. Alternative text is Green and yellow color blocks, 64 by 32 pixels.

image/image-wrap-tight.docx.observation: Word PDF shows the same green/yellow rectangle floating on the right, with after 后文 to its left. For this rectangular picture the visible outline matches square wrapping, while the package confirms wp:wrapTight with wp:wrapPolygon. 144 x 72 pt, embedded PNG, no crop/rotation/flip/link; alternative text describes the two color blocks.

image/image-behind.docx.observation: Word PDF shows the green/yellow rectangle on the right, with before 前文 and after 后文 on the left; this short text does not overlap the picture, so the PDF alone cannot distinguish front from behind. Word COM uses behind-text wrapping and the package confirms wp:wrapNone with behindDoc=1. 144 x 72 pt, embedded PNG, no crop/rotation/flip/link; color-block alternative text.

image/image-front.docx.observation: Word PDF shows the green/yellow rectangle on the right, with before 前文 and after 后文 on the left. The text does not cross the image, so no actual text occlusion is visible. Word COM uses in-front-of-text wrapping and the package confirms wp:wrapNone with behindDoc=0. 144 x 72 pt, embedded PNG, no crop/rotation/flip/link; color-block alternative text.

image/image-top-bottom.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文 above the green/yellow floating rectangle and after 后文 below its bottom. Top/bottom wrapping is visibly effective and wp:wrapTopAndBottom is present. Image is 144 x 72 pt at horizontal offset 180 pt; embedded PNG, no crop/rotation/flip/link; color-block alternative text.

image/image-cropped.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文, then a smaller inline rectangle with only a narrow green strip at the left and a much wider yellow region, then after 后文. Left and top were cropped by 18 and 9 source pt; displayed size is 90 x 45 pt. a:srcRect is present. Embedded PNG with no rotation, flip or external link; color-block alternative text.

image/image-svg.docx.observation: Word PDF shows a crisp green-left/yellow-right rectangle inline between the before/after markers. Inserted source is a 64 x 32 SVG, displayed at 144 x 72 pt. Package contains word/media/image2.svg, a PNG fallback, and asvg:svgBlip. No crop/rotation/flip/external link; alternative text describes the two color blocks.

image/image-linked.docx.observation: Word PDF shows the green/yellow rectangle correctly, inline between before 前文 and after 后文, while the source asset exists locally. 144 x 72 pt, linked-only PNG: a:blip has r:link and no r:embed, and there is no word/media part. Source is the delivered _assets/tiny.png; successful rendering on another machine depends on resolving that external link. No crop/rotation/flip; color-block alternative text.

image/image-insert-and-link.docx.observation: Word PDF shows the same green/yellow rectangle inline between both markers. 144 x 72 pt; the same a:blip has r:embed and r:link, with an embedded PNG and an external link to _assets/tiny.png. No crop, rotation, or flip; alternative text describes the color blocks.

image/image-rotated.docx.observation: Word PDF shows a diagonal floating rectangle, yellow at lower-left and green at upper-right. The first trial set Rotation=45 then applied horizontal Flip; Word changed the final rotation to 315 degrees, saving rot=18900000 and flipH=1. The final rotation therefore differs from literal 45 degrees; retain this trial and use a corrected suffixed version that flips before setting Rotation=45. Square wrapping, 144 x 72 pt, embedded PNG, no crop/link; both markers remain visible at the left.

image/image-rotated-2.docx.observation: Corrected Word PDF shows a diagonal floating rectangle with yellow at upper-left and green at lower-right; both markers remain visible on the left. Final Word rotation is 45 degrees with a horizontal flip: a:xfrm rot=2700000 and flipH=1. Square wrapping, 144 x 72 pt before rotation, embedded PNG with no crop or external link. The flip was applied before setting the final rotation.

image/image-alt-decorative.docx.observation: Word PDF shows the ordinary green/yellow inline rectangle between before 前文 and after 后文. Decorative status has no distinct visual appearance; Word COM Decorative=-1 succeeded and the package contains decorative val=1 extensions. 144 x 72 pt, embedded PNG, no crop/rotation/flip/link. The source was marked decorative through Word's actual object model, not by editing XML.

image/image-two-in-run.docx.observation: Word PDF shows before 前文, then two adjacent inline rectangles without any visible gap, giving the sequence green/yellow/green/yellow, then after 后文. Each picture is 144 x 72 pt, embedded PNG, with no crop/rotation/flip/link. The document has two picture drawings in the same paragraph and no intervening text.
